length = int(input())
limit = int(input())
sequence = [int(input()) for _ in range(length)]

bucket_counts = [0] * 101
current_sum = 0

even_counter = 0
odd_counter = 0
segment_start = 0
total_segments = 0
pointer_index = 1

i = 0
while i < len(sequence) - 1:
    if sequence[i] % 2 == 0:
        even_counter += 1
    else:
        odd_counter += 1

    if even_counter == odd_counter:
        difference = abs(sequence[i + 1] - sequence[i])
        max_bucket_value = None
        for j in range(len(bucket_counts) - 1, -1, -1):
            if bucket_counts[j] > 0:
                max_bucket_value = j
                break
        if max_bucket_value is None:
            max_bucket_value = -1

        if current_sum > limit and difference < max_bucket_value:
            current_sum -= max_bucket_value
            bucket_counts[max_bucket_value] -= 1
            bucket_counts[difference] += 1
            current_sum += difference
        elif current_sum < limit:
            current_sum += difference
            bucket_counts[difference] += 1
            total_segments += 1
            segment_start = i + 1
        if i == len(sequence) - 2 and pointer_index < len(sequence) - 1:
            i = segment_start
            segment_start += 1
            even_counter = 0
            odd_counter = 0
            continue
    i += 1

i = len(bucket_counts) - 1
while current_sum > limit:
    if bucket_counts[i] > 0:
        current_sum -= i
        total_segments -= 1
    else:
        i -= 1

print(total_segments)
